experiments.name: multiplication_based_activation_spreading
experiments.reason: Replacing OR/shift activation widening with multiplication allows overlapping fields to carry into retained fields.
experiments.resolution: Retained OR/shift for activations. Multiplication is used only for weight dilation where copied fields provably do not overlap.

experiments.name: low_optimizer_runs
experiments.reason: Runs 1 and 200 reduced bytecode size but increased representative execution gas compared with runs 10000 and 1000000.

experiments.name: aligned_bf16_endpoints
experiments.reason: Avoided bit extraction but still reconstructed scales during execution. Precomputed exact scales performed better.
